findings.title: Step Functions state machine without logging
findings.description: Without a logging_configuration, state machine executions leave no CloudWatch trail, blinding incident response. Configure logging_configuration with a log destination.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: Step Functions state machine without X-Ray tracing
findings.description: X-Ray tracing maps execution flow across Lambda and service integrations, the primary signal for spotting abused workflows. Enable it with tracing_configuration { enabled = true }.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
